summary: Steel lookout in Shasta-Trinity NF, dated 1977 by the register; its lookout first spotted the 1992 Fountain Fire. Not on the Forest Service rental list.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan C16, a revision of the CL-100 all steel design; the cab sits on a 9-foot brick tower
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Shasta-Trinity National Forest

visit.trail_note: Hogback is not among the Forest Service lookouts and guard stations offered for rent. Public access to the tower is not confirmed in the sources read.

events.note: Register: the current structure was constructed in 1977. The register's wording implies an earlier structure, which the sources read do not identify.
Fountain Fire, August 20, 1992: a lookout atop Hogback Mountain first spotted it at about 12:50 p.m., reporting smoke near a historic drinking fountain along Highway 299

notes_for_editor: Brief kind 'two_story' is not supported by the register text read, which describes a cab on a 9-foot brick tower; it is not carried into facts. Status 'standing' rests on the FFLA California Standing list (the register text itself gives no status) and the register's photos from 2008 and 2009; no later source was read. The FFLA list's '2-StoryCab' label conflicts with the register's brick-tower description and is not used. Access and visit status are unconfirmed; the Forest Service rental list omitting Hogback is not proof of closure. The Fountain Fire spotting comes from Wikipedia, which cites its own sources; it was not checked against a 1992 fire report, so verify before relying on it. Staffing is unknown; a search summary claimed CalFire staffs it as conditions require, but no page was read to confirm, so it is omitted. No height in the brief or register beyond the cab on a 9-foot brick tower; no height_m given. No photos added.
